sentences.text: Eric Lynn Wright -LRB- September 7 , 1964March 26 , 1995 -RRB- , better known by his stage name Eazy-E , was an American rapper who performed solo and in the hip hop group N.W.A. Wright is affectionately called `` The Godfather of Gangsta rap '' .	Gangsta rap	Gangsta rap	N.W.A	N.W.A	rapper	Rapping	hip hop	Hip hop music
He was born to Richard and Kathie Wright in Compton , California .	Compton	Compton, California	California	California

After dropping out of high school in the tenth grade , he supported himself primarily by selling drugs before founding Ruthless Records and becoming a rapper .	Ruthless	Ruthless Records	rapper	Rapping	selling drugs	Illegal drug trade	Ruthless Records	Ruthless Records
Arabian Prince , Eazy-E , Dr. Dre and Ice Cube formed N.W.A. .	N.W.A	N.W.A	Dr. Dre	Dr. Dre	Ice Cube	Ice Cube	Arabian Prince	Arabian Prince

In 1988 , they released their most controversial album , Straight Outta Compton .	Compton	Compton, California	Straight Outta Compton	Straight Outta Compton
The group released two more albums and then disbanded after Eazy released Dr. Dre from his contract .	Dr. Dre	Dr. Dre
Eazy 's main influences included 1970s funk groups , contemporary rappers , and comedians .

When reviewing Eazy 's albums , many critics noted his unique overall style , with Steve Huey of the All Music Guide remarking : `` While his technical skills as a rapper were never the greatest , his distinctive delivery ... over-the-top lyrics , and undeniable charisma made him a star .
